x: Startup India was launched on 16 January 2016 (now National Startup Day). Stand-Up India was launched on 5 April 2016, not in January 2015, so only the Startup India pair is correct.

PM-KUSUM in Andhra Pradesh covers 2.93 lakh pumps. PM Surya Ghar uses Virtual Net Metering with an SC/ST focus, so it is neither limited to large industries nor about coal-fired generation, and no forest land is reserved for coal mining.

Statement 2 is false: demonetisation was not part of the 1991 package (India's demonetisations were in 1978 and 2016). Statement 1 is true because full capital-account convertibility was never adopted. Statements 3 and 4 (automatic-route FDI in high-priority industries; devaluation, tariff cuts and removal of import quotas) were 1991 measures, so the answer is 1, 3 and 4.

The Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Central (Amendment) Rules, 2018 extended fixed-term employment to all sectors. They made it easier for firms to end employment and removed the need for a termination notice for a temporary workman. All three statements are correct, as in the UPSC 2019 key.
